cross_product_finding: Same management-plane/data-plane split as CREATE BUCKET (see createbucket.json for the general reasoning). Additionally notable: this page's Purpose section describes the object being created as 'a new local user in the Couchbase Server Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system' - the doc text itself names 'Couchbase Server RBAC', not a distinct 'Capella RBAC'. This suggests the underlying data-plane role/privilege engine that CREATE USER/CREATE GROUP/GRANT/REVOKE operate on is shared/inherited from server/'s RBAC implementation, and it is only the front door - who is allowed to invoke CREATE/DROP/GRANT/REVOKE at all - that Capella gates differently (via the management-plane role checked here) . This matters for the ontology: the RBAC role/privilege taxonomy itself (cluster_admin, query_select, data_reader, etc.) may not need a Capella-specific parallel taxonomy at all - only the execution-gating layer is genuinely new. Contrast this with grant.md/revoke.md, whose parameter tables instead attribute the same role concept to 'Couchbase Capella' - see grant.json for that inconsistency.
